stories.title: "When it’s time to eat the rich and I get Kim Kardashian"
stories.summary: An ASMR creator posted a clip of himself chewing on a clear silicone pad, captioned "when it’s time to eat the rich and I get Kim Kardashian", a dig at how much of her is supposedly plastic. It passed 300K likes within a day, the quote posts piled on, and people reused the format with other celebrities.
